name: xiao-nrf52840-ble
description: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 BLE Sense (1MB flash, 256KB SRAM), HSE 32MHz -> 64MHz. RGB LED (user) on P0.26 red / P0.30 green / P0.31 blue, charge LED on P0.17. Console UART0: TX P0.06 / RX P0.08 @115200. I2C1 SCL P0.27 / SDA P0.26 (internal IMU LSM6DS3 + PDM mic on same bus). SWD pads + USB DFU (Adafruit nRF52 bootloader).
